en-US.title: I went to eat gamjatang and received applause.
en-US.description:
Hello everyone 👋🏻

It's been a while since I greeted you with a long video!

This is one of my wife Sso's favorite songs, so I've always wanted to sing it someday.

I had a great time singing it while enjoying some Gamjatang and a glass of soda (?) 😁 haha

I filmed today's video with the meal and location provided 👍🏻

I sang a song and ate a delicious meal until I was stuffed before coming back :)

Thank you to the owner of 'Nurimaeul Gamjatang' Yeongdo branch for providing the meal ❤️
